Senior Financial Analyst, Wipro — Nov 2018 - Present

Partnered with product and engineering teams using Jira to track finance requirements and change requests; integrated outputs into Financial Modeling deliverables and executive decks. Used Git to version-control model templates and maintain audit trails for model changes.

Directed budgeting and rolling forecast process for a SaaS portfolio, creating Financial Modeling frameworks for subscription revenue and churn scenarios. Drove FP&A reporting improvements that clarified margin drivers and supported pricing decisions presented to the leadership team. Implemented standardized templates and controls to support handoff into SAP FICO ledgers for month-end postings.

Skills: Financial Modeling, FP&A, SAP FICO, Jira, Git
